map.患者体型中等，取足三里（肌层较厚），标准进针约 30–40mm、药液 2–4mL: For a patient of medium build, Zusanli is chosen (the muscle layer is thicker); standard insertion is about 30-40 mm with 2-4 mL of solution. For children or thin patients, reduce to 15-25 mm and 1-2 mL to avoid injuring the deep peroneal nerve by inserting too deeply.
